broadcasts.message: normalize.js ready: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to one space, trim. Non-string returns empty string. No word changes. Awaiting tokenizer and pipeline.
tokenizer.js implemented. tokenize(text) normalizes then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, preserving order. Ready for pipeline.

pipeline.js ready. processText will call injected tokenize(text) and return exact object with text as joined tokens, tokens array, count, unique first-seen, and frequencies as null-prototype object to avoid prototype collisions. No filtering or sentiment changes. Ready to integrate with your normalize/tokenize output.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 1: I own normalize.js. Requirements: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. No word reordering/add/drop. Handle non-string input by returning empty string? Spec says 'for string input' — I'll return '' for non-string to be safe. Next rounds: verify tokenizer and pipeline interfaces; no shadowing. Keep normalize pure and minimal.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 1: Implement tokenizer.js per spec. tokenize(text) calls injected normalize(text), then regex [A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)* to extract tokens in order. No stopwords, preserve negation. Future: ensure pipeline compatibility.
private_memories.integrator: Round 1: I am the pipeline.js integrator. My job: processText(text) calls injected tokenize(text), returns {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. Must handle prototype keys (constructor) via Object.create(null) for frequencies and unique Set. text = tokens.join(' '). Keep faithful, no filtering. Need to coordinate with peers: normalize and tokenize are injected. No shadowing. Next rounds: verify interface compatibility.
